manual_review.selection: First 120 holdout LNK001 diagnostics ordered by SHA-256 diagnostic ID; all 47 source-verification exceptions additionally inspected.
manual_review.review_method: Independent agent read original UTF-8 link uses, surrounding prose/code boundaries, and reference definitions in four batches of 30 holdout cases and inspected all suspicious reference cases. The complete pinned tree oracle supplies physical existence evidence. This is agent review, not human annotation. No Rust resolver or rule code was used and no thresholds were tuned.

findings.evidence: All 120 sampled uses are static Markdown links or images whose exact repository targets are absent. Vue and Goose links frequently use site-style roots or extensionless routes; Rust book links target HTML paths; uv links target absent reference Markdown. These satisfy the physical-checkout contract and do not establish broken live sites. Build outputs require documented suppression under LNK001.
All 42 initially unresolved source spans are valid reference definitions with destinations on the following line. Original use labels, definition labels, and destination bytes match.

Five tuning diagnostics in ruff/docs/formatter.md export the reference key configuredquote style, while original use and definition both say configured quote style. Original destination settings.md/#format_quote-style is unchanged and its physical target docs/settings.md is absent. This metadata discrepancy does not alter the LNK001 classification.

All flagged destinations have literal original byte matches and contain no template markers, percent escapes, backslashes, whitespace, or entities. The independent resolver treats dynamic, malformed, outside-workspace, symlink, submodule, and duplicate-path cases as uncertain. Precision describes emitted diagnostics only and is not a recall measurement.
